subject: Migration documentation: Someone with experience Joomla or other  CMSs?

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Migration documentation: Someone with experience Joomla or other  CMSs?
parts:
Hi,

has any of you experience with Joomla, Drupal or other content
management systems (CMSs)? We wish/need to migrate the documentation
from the current aroma.affymetrix Google Group to a CMS (or a maybe
only a basic wiki). We can easily install and setup Joomla, Joomla
v1.5, Drupal and a few others. What I realized is that it will take
some skills to update the templates and organize the sections etc. As
soon as the main structure/strategy is setup we can start
copy'n'pasting from the Google Group Pages.

We'd appreciate if anyone with experience on this would like to pitch
in on this (or just give further suggestions).

Henrik

Hi David,

thanks - after doing some investigations, it turns out that DJango is
not (easily/at all?) supported by the shared-server program we are
using in our web hosting, cf.

http://www.a2hosting.com/blog/django-vps-hosting/

That's a petty.

The Content Management (CM) ones that are supported and available out
of the box are: Drupal, Geeklog, Joomla 1.5, Joomla, Mambo, PHP-Nuke,
phpWCMS, phpWebSite, Post-Nuke, Siteframe, TYPO3, and Xoops.

/Henrik
